title.narrative: SARC Livelihood support to vulnerable communities

description.narrative:
SARC, in line with their own strategy to better prepare affected peoples with resilient and greener solutions to Livelihood recovery and maintenance will implement the following Livelihood project with BRC support. The objective of the project is to empower vulnerable communities by enhancing their skills and providing financial support to meet their necessities, thereby promoting long-term sustainability and self-sufficiency. Key Activities will include
Business Management Training:
Provide training in financial management, resource allocation, project life cycles, and strategic planning. Equip individuals affected by crises with the skills needed to manage their businesses effectively during the recovery phase.
Cash Assistance:
Distribute grants known as ‘Cash for Livelihood’ to support small-scale Income-Generating Activity (IGA) projects. Enable beneficiaries to rebuild businesses, purchase essential supplies, and undertake actions that contribute to community resilience.
Systematic Monitoring:
Implement a systematic approach to oversee the advancement of businesses over a six-month period. Conduct regular monthly follow-ups to observe and document business progress. Identify growth, challenges, and areas needing improvement through the monitoring process.
Expected Outcomes:
Enhanced skills and knowledge in business management among beneficiaries. Rebuilt and sustained livelihoods through effective use of cash assistance. Strengthened community resilience against adverse events such as natural disasters and economic downturns. Creation of sustainable income sources, securing basic needs, and providing a buffer against potential risks.
This project aims to provide immediate relief while fostering long-term economic stability and resilience within vulnerable communities. The systematic monitoring approach ensures continuous support and improvement, helping businesses thrive and adapt to challenges.
